description: This file defines an interface 'AbstractVariableSet' for managing a set of variables within the Java Evaluator ('Javaluator') library. It provides a method to retrieve variable values by name, supporting expression evaluation with variables.

classes.name: AbstractVariableSet
classes.description: An interface representing a set of variables that can return values for variable names during expression evaluation.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves the value of a variable given its name. Returns the variable's value or null if unknown.
